items.claim: Taimuraz got suspended for a tainted supplement in his heart medication.
items.quote: he did get suspended for a tainted tainted supplement, but we're not talking steroids. It was something like in his heart medication.

items.claim: Taimuraz is a good fighter who can find finishes with a ton of experience and solid wins.
items.quote: Taimuraz is a good fighter who can find finishes. He has a ton of experience, and he's got some good solid wins.

items.claim: Steve Erceg does not have good wins and is overrated.
items.quote: You know who does not have good wins? Steve Erceg... I just don't think he's a very good fighter. I think he's overrated.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who added some striking and high fight IQ, getting by on favorable matchups.
items.quote: I think Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ... and B, his fight IQ.

items.claim: Steve Erceg can be finished and lacks takedown defense.
items.quote: Steve Erceg can be finished. We watched him get knocked out by Kai Kara-France... He just can't defend a freaking takedown.

items.claim: Magomed Ankalaev is long, uses his length well, and has wrestling as a backup plan.
items.quote: He's long, he uses length pretty well. He has wrestling as a backup plan.

items.claim: Ankalaev was sick or injured going into his recent loss to Alex Pereira.
items.quote: What was he? Sick or injured, whatever it was going into his last fight, I believe it.

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks notice.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov is stepping up on two weeks notice. Now, he was in camp. He was supposed to be fighting next week

items.claim: Bogdan Guskov has big one-punch knockout power and can head hunt.
items.quote: Bogdan Guskov does have big one-punch knockout power, and he can head hunt, and he can find that spot.
